name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
rule: A raw pointer to an unaligned packed field constructed with `&raw const` may be passed to `read_unaligned`, provided the pointer is valid for reading `size_of::<T>()` bytes, points to a properly initialized `T`, and the read obeys the non-atomic-access restrictions.
api: const unsafe fn read_unaligned < T > (src : * const T) -> T
